tourLiveText: Channels sorted into groups, with what's on now and next and a full TV guide.
tourVodText: Browse each source's movie and series posters, filter by decade, and save titles to My List to keep them in one place.
tourSearchText: Find channels, movies and series across all your sources.
whatsNewEmpty: No release notes for this version yet.
noteMultiviewText: Watch up to four live channels at once. Click a tile to give it the sound.
noteParentalText: Lock channels, groups or titles behind a PIN, or hide them completely.
noteMyListText: Save movies and series from their poster and find them again on the dashboard.
noteListsText: Mix channels from any source into lists, and rename or hide single channels.
noteGuideText: Search programmes, jump to any day and time, and record every airing of a show.
noteSubtitlesText: Load .srt, .vtt or .ass files and set the size, color, background and position.
noteSleepText: Stop playback after a set time or when the programme ends, with a gentle fade.
noteVodFiltersText: Filter movies and series by year and hide what you have already watched.
noteStatsText: See your viewing time per day and your top channels and titles.
noteLooksText: Seven accent colors, an OLED black theme, compact density and interface size.
noteScreenshotText: Press S during playback to save the current frame as an image.
noteSpeedText: Posters and logos are kept on disk, so grids load at once the next time.
